notes.title: Patch April 21st
notes.content:
ADDED:

Save system added game will now auto save progress at certain points as you progress the game.

Start Over button on main menu will delete all saved data and start a new game.

Retry button added to death screen will respawn you to your last checkpoint 

FIXED:

Print string after one year later appearing on screen

Small UI fix to pause screen
